name: new-hope-7-ios-wrapper
description: Native iOS wrapper for New Hope 7 stable web release 2.3.9

scripts.prepare: npm run prepare:web && npm run build:bridge
scripts.ios:add: npm run prepare && npx cap add ios && npm run ios:assets && npm run ios:configure
scripts.ios:sync: npm run prepare && ONESIGNAL_DISABLE_LOCATION=true npx cap sync ios && npm run ios:assets && npm run ios:configure
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && ONESIGNAL_DISABLE_LOCATION=true npx cap run ios
